methodology: Local production server, fresh browser context per journey; one second after home load; real link clicks timed in browser through changed visible destination H1 plus two animation frames. Same-origin GET/HEAD only, optional consent denied. Route interception disables browser HTTP caching; Next router prefetch cache remains active. Unthrottled local timings are functional evidence, not a WAN speed guarantee.
